note: 51 -> 48. All three are ir_qweb_fields.py, and all three are builtin raises: TypeError for a monetary value that is not a number, and the two ValueErrors the time widget raises for a negative or out-of-range hour. `_()` around a builtin exception is the category error E8511 names -- these reach a reader as a traceback, never as a dialog -- and translating them had booked three developer diagnostics into base.pot. Two more that this same change would have ADDED (a non-finite float, an unknown duration unit) were written as f-strings for the same reason, which is also why translation_catalog holds at 520 rather than 522.
